raw_input: Congratulations! You have been selected for a guaranteed returns crypto program. Send $500 in bitcoin or a google play card today to secure your slot. This is a private matter - do not tell anyone.
classification_rationale: Findings indicate suspicious activity. The deterministic score is 7 points (0 high / 1 medium / 1 low indicators), but no authoritative threat-feed hit was required for this band. Treat the destination as untrusted until independently verified.

findings.title: Payment method (cryptocurrency) combined with secrecy instructions
evidence: This combination is common in scams, but remains suspicious language, not verified evidence of fraud.

findings.title: Message uses social-engineering language patterns
evidence: impersonation: "google" — Claims to be a known organisation or authority.
too_good_to_be_true: "you have been selected", "congratulations", "guaranteed returns" — Unrealistic reward offered for little effort.
secrecy: "do not tell anyone", "private matter" — Instructs the recipient to hide the interaction — classic fraud isolation tactic.
Persuasive or urgent wording alone does NOT make a message fraudulent; legitimate organisations sometimes write badly. These are soft indicators only.

threat_intel.note: Absence of intel hits is not proof of safety — many providers require an API key and are unavailable in this build by default.

ct_history.note: CT logs are public and read-only; data may lag minutes to hours.
